items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: We knew we had engagements to fill and we thought right away of Nat Pierce

ctx.x: Was anybody thinking or worrying, I mean, had he felt bad or anything, or was it totally sudden?

I don't know. I was in the hotel -- the same hotel he was in, and I didn't know anything until the next morning, and he was, like, -- right across -- a couple of doors away from me, you know. He had to walk up some steps to come to his room, see? We both had. So, I didn't know anything until the next morning. I came out, you know, and the guys were standing outside. So, I walked over and said, you know -- "What's happening? Good morning." -- and what not. He said -- "Don't you know? Basie had a heart-attack."…
Yeah. They went along with it very well, didn't they?
